payload.title: pyODV
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to visualize oceanographic data using Python, similar to the Ocean Data Viewer software. It focuses on loading and processing gridded data from the World Ocean Atlas, specifically using xarray and fsspec to handle Zarr data formats. The notebook includes methods for creating various types of plots, such as surface, section, profile, and scatter plots, to analyze oceanographic variables like salinity and isotopic compositions. The final output is a dashboard that integrates these visualizations to provide a comprehensive view of the data.
goals: Create plots similar to Ocean Data Viewer.
Process and analyze gridded data from the World Ocean Atlas.
techniques: Data loading with xarray and fsspec
Creating surface, section, profile, and scatter plots
